children: The finance veteran brings experience across corporate finance, restructuring, cost management and transformation from Embibe, DEN Networks and Vedanta Group

Harigovind Krishnasamy has joined Digitide as Chief Financial Officer, taking charge of the company’s finance function in August 2026. He moves to Digitide after serving as CFO at Matrimony.com and earlier leading finance at Reliance Jio Group company Embibe.

Krishnasamy joins Digitide after more than five years at Embibe, where he served as CFO from April 2021 to June 2025. During his tenure, he worked on finance and HR process standardisation, business modelling, automation and cost management initiatives.
Before joining Digitide, he was CFO at Matrimony.com from July 2025 to August 2026.

His experience spans finance leadership across technology, education, broadband and mining businesses, with responsibilities covering corporate finance, controllership, restructuring and operational finance.

Krishnasamy began his career with Vedanta in 2004 as a management trainee. During his tenure, he worked on US GAAP conversion for a NYSE listing and SOX implementation, besides handling commercial negotiations and project finance assignments.

He later spent more than five years with Konkola Copper Mines in Zambia as Business Controller. His responsibilities included business restructuring, manpower rationalisation, internal controls and finance-led technology initiatives.

In 2015, he moved to DEN Networks as Vice President Finance and Broadband CFO. There, he worked on cost reduction, debt restructuring, internal controls, reporting and finance automation, including an SAP HANA implementation.

At Embibe, Krishnasamy worked on finance and HR process standardisation, procurement and legal process automation and ERP implementation. He also worked on a zero-based business model designed to track business actions and financial outcomes.
His career has included projects involving cost optimisation, debt restructuring, operational efficiency and process automation across multiple sectors.
Krishnasamy qualified as a Chartered Accountant in 2004 and completed all three levels of the CFA programme. He holds a B.Com degree from Kamaraj University.
At Digitide, his new mandate adds another CFO role to a career spanning more than two decades across finance controllership, corporate finance, restructuring and business transformation.
